about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Korean Chojang Chilli Vinegar Dip
recipes.summary: A bright, sweet-sour chilli and vinegar dip for dumplings, pancakes and grilled meat.
steps: Whisk the gochujang, vinegar, honey and water together until smooth.
Stir in the sesame oil and seeds.
Spoon into a small dish and serve with dumplings or pancakes.
notes: Check the gochujang label for gluten.

recipes.title: Korean Yangnyeom Soy Garlic Sauce
recipes.summary: A sticky soy, garlic and honey glaze for fried chicken, tofu and roasted vegetables.
steps: Simmer the soy sauce, honey, garlic, vinegar and ginger in a small pan for 4 minutes until syrupy.
Remove from the heat and stir in the sesame oil.
Use to coat hot chicken, tofu or vegetables until glossy.

recipes.title: Cold Cucumber and Buttermilk Soup with Chives
recipes.summary: A cooling no-cook soup of cucumber and buttermilk with lemon and chives, ready in ten minutes.
steps: Blend the cucumbers, buttermilk, lemon juice, garlic and salt until completely smooth.
Chill for at least 1 hour, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
Pour into bowls, drizzle with the oil and scatter with chives.
notes: Use thick plant yoghurt thinned with water for dairy-free.

recipes.title: Chilled Zucchini and Basil Soup
recipes.summary: A pale green soup of gently cooked zucchini and fresh basil, served cold with a swirl of olive oil.
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp of the oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the zucchini and stock and simmer for 8 minutes until completely tender.
Blend with the basil, lemon juice and salt until smooth, then chill until very cold.
Pour into bowls and drizzle with the remaining oil.
notes: Cool the soup quickly and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Cold Carrot and Orange Soup
recipes.summary: A sunny chilled soup of carrot, orange juice and ginger with a spoon of yoghurt.
steps: Cook the onion and ginger in the oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the carrots and stock and simmer for 18 minutes until completely tender.
Blend with the orange juice and salt until smooth and chill until very cold.
Serve topped with yoghurt and coriander.
notes: Leave out the yoghurt for vegan.

recipes.title: Chilled Roasted Capsicum Soup
recipes.summary: Sweet roasted red capsicum blended with tomato and a little cream, served cold with basil.
steps: Roast the capsicums, tomatoes and garlic at 220°C for 30 minutes until the skins blister and blacken.
Peel the capsicums and tomatoes and remove the seeds.
Blend with the oil, stock, vinegar and salt until completely smooth.
Stir in the cream, chill until very cold and top with basil.

recipes.title: Corn Cob Stock
recipes.summary: A sweet, light stock made from the cobs left after cutting off the kernels.
steps: Break the cobs in half and place in a large pot with the onion, carrot, celery, parsley, bay leaf and water.
Bring to a boil, then simmer gently for 40 minutes until the stock tastes sweet and golden.
Strain, season with the salt and cool.
notes: Use for chowders, risotto and soups.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Thyme Stock
recipes.summary: A dark, savoury vegetarian stock built on mushrooms, onion and thyme.
steps: Brown the mushrooms and onion in the oil in a large pot for 10 minutes until deeply golden.
Add the carrot, garlic, water, thyme, bay leaves and soy sauce.
Simmer gently for 40 minutes until the stock turns dark and fragrant.
Strain through a fine sieve.

recipes.title: Roasted Garlic and Herb Vegetable Broth
recipes.summary: A golden, aromatic broth of roasted garlic, leek and herbs, good for sipping or soups.
steps: Cut the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with the oil and roast at 200°C for 30 minutes until soft and golden.
Place the roasted garlic, leeks, carrots, celery, water, bay leaf, thyme and parsley in a large pot.
Simmer gently for 30 minutes until the broth is fragrant, then strain and season with the salt.
notes: Squeeze the leftover roasted garlic into mash or bread.

recipes.title: Garlic Roasted Cabbage Wedges
recipes.summary: Cabbage wedges roasted until crisp at the edges and sweet inside, finished with lemon.
steps: Brush the wedges with the oil and place on a tray with the garlic.
Roast at 220°C for 25 minutes, turning once, until the edges are crisp and charred and the centres are tender.
Season with the salt, chilli and lemon juice and serve.
notes: Keep the core in so the wedges hold together.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Roasted Onions
recipes.summary: Whole small onions roasted until jammy with a honey and wholegrain mustard glaze.
steps: Toss the onion halves with the oil, salt and thyme in a roasting tray, cut side down.
Roast at 200°C for 30 minutes until soft and golden.
Stir the honey, mustard and vinegar together, spoon over the onions and roast for 10 minutes until glossy and sticky.
notes: Good with roast meat or a cheese board.

recipes.title: Herb Roasted Baby Potatoes with Lemon
recipes.summary: Crisp-skinned baby potatoes roasted with rosemary, garlic and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Toss the potatoes with the oil, garlic, rosemary and salt on a large tray.
Roast at 220°C for 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden and a knife slides in easily.
Toss with the lemon zest, juice and parsley and serve hot.

recipes.title: Buttered Corn with Chives
recipes.summary: Sweet corn kernels tossed in butter with chives, pepper and a squeeze of lime.
steps: Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the corn kernels for 6 minutes, stirring, until tender and lightly golden.
Stir in the chives, lime juice, salt and pepper and serve hot.
notes: Use olive oil instead of butter for vegan.

recipes.title: Orzo Salad with Lemon and Peas
recipes.summary: Tender orzo tossed with peas, mint, feta and a lemon dressing, good warm or cold.
steps: Boil the orzo in salted water for 9 minutes until al dente, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes until bright green.
Drain and toss with the oil, lemon zest, juice and salt while still warm.
Fold in the feta, mint and spring onions.

recipes.title: Barley and Roasted Capsicum Salad
recipes.summary: Chewy barley with smoky roasted capsicum, rocket and a sherry vinegar dressing.
steps: Roast the capsicums at 220°C for 30 minutes until blistered and soft, then peel, deseed and slice.
Simmer the barley in plenty of water for 30 minutes until tender, then drain and cool.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, garlic and salt and toss through the barley with the capsicums, rocket and almonds until coated.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Cucumber Grain Salad
recipes.summary: Brown rice, chickpeas and crisp cucumber with parsley and a lemon tahini dressing.
steps: Simmer the rice in plenty of water for 28 minutes until tender, then drain and cool.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, water, garlic and salt until smooth.
Toss the rice with the chickpeas, cucumbers, parsley and dressing until coated.
notes: Food safety: cool and refrigerate the cooked rice within 1 hour and eat within 1 day.
